title: Cancel
description: From Core (or from an operator interface to Core, which checks it and passes it on): stop a command. It never creates a Task. With task_id, Core passes it on only for a Task that has not finished, and refuses an unknown or finished one. A queued Task is dropped and the running one carries on; an active one stops. Without task_id, stop whatever motion is running now. When motion stops, the Asset holds (hovers in place, or stays on the ground) and sets run_state paused, so it does not start the next Task until resumed. It reports the Task cancelled, then its queue, and answers every cancel with report.settings (reply_to this seq). For a Task it already finished it changes nothing and resends that Task's final report; for one it has not received yet, it remembers it as cancelled, reports it cancelled and never runs it.
